packageRules.description: Patch/minor bumps are safe to roll out unattended — the weekly VM update run (scripts/update-containers.sh) takes a fresh backup and health-checks before/after. The repo has no CI, so the only status check on a Renovate branch is Renovate's own renovate/stability-days, which by default does not count towards a green branch — without internalChecksAsSuccess the branch never turns green and nothing is ever automerged.

Major bumps (e.g. postgres 17->18) can mean incompatible on-disk data or breaking changes — always reviewed manually, never auto-merged. maxMajorIncrement above keeps each PR to a single major step: Nextcloud refuses to start when a major is skipped (33 -> 35), so 34 -> 35 is only offered once 33 -> 34 is merged.
